title: RuleCard
description: Schema for patent office examination rule cards. A Rule Card is a modular JSON file extracted from official patent office examination guidelines.

card_id.description: Unique identifier for this rule card

version.description: Version string for this rule card (e.g. '2026.1')

source_document.description: Reference to the official source document from which rules were extracted

title.description: Title of the official source document

edition.description: Edition or year of the source document

url.description: URL to the official online version of the source document

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of this card's content

translated_from.description: Original language code if this card was translated, null otherwise

last_updated.description: Date this card was last updated (ISO 8601 date: YYYY-MM-DD)

tags.description: Searchable tags for categorization and filtering

rules.description: Array of examination rules extracted from the source document

review_checklist.description: Checklist items for the reviewer to verify

system_prompt_injection.description: Text injected into the LLM system prompt when this card is active

Rule.description: A single examination rule extracted from an official guideline

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for this rule within the card

severity.description: How strictly this rule must be followed

exceptions.description: Cases where this rule does not apply

compliant.description: Example of correct application of this rule

non_compliant.description: Example of incorrect application of this rule

examples.description: Compliant and non-compliant examples, or null if not provided

reference.description: Citation to the specific section in the source document
